headline: Starbucks (SBUX) Nears Q3 Earnings, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
summary: Starbucks (SBUX) is back in focus as Wall Street sets expectations for its upcoming fiscal Q3 report, with analysts projecting earnings of $0.66 per share and slightly lower revenue. See our latest analysis for Starbucks. At a share price of $103.25, Starbucks has seen its 1 year to date share price return of 22.96% contrast with a 12.24% 1 year total shareholder return, with recent headlines around its turnaround plans and expectations for Q3 earnings keeping sentiment focused on whether...
